text:
maria: Hey team — incoming escalation from ACME (support-#1298). They saw a sharp p99 increase after we onboarded eden-v1 yesterday. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate (hosted-us-east-1). Long-context requests (>50k tokens) mostly. Sample request + minimal logs attached. Anyone oncall?

sanjay: Can you paste the raw request and tokenizer metadata? Did we change the tokenizer merges or normalization for eden-v1?

maria: sample payload:
```json
{
  "model": "eden-v1",
  "input": "<...very long document with lots of CJK chars...>",
  "max_tokens": 32768
}
```
Tokenization timing from their trace: tokenization 1.9s -> 3.7s per request, total p99 jump from 420ms -> 2.1s. Host: hosted-us-east-1-a, route: /v1/generate

kevin: I'm oncall. Initial hypothesis: tokenizer fallback slowpath due to large non-ascii sequences + new merge table. Can we see model manifest for eden-v1? Also any changes to kvcache invalidation policy?

noah: I pulled the manifest — eden-v1 uses bytepair v2 with normalization enabled (NFKC) and added new merges. kv-cache TTL unchanged. My local microbench shows tokenization cost goes up 2.5x for long CJK-run inputs. Repro script:
```
# repro
python -c "import requests, json; r=requests.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', json={'model':'eden-v1','input':'好'*60000,'max_tokens':32}, headers={'Authorization':'Bearer REDACT'}); print(r.elapsed.total_seconds())"
```

sanjay: Thanks. That matches. Two mitigations: 1) revert eden-v1 tokenizer merges to eden-v1-tok-legacy; 2) enable streaming tokenization/cached tokenization for long prefixes (prefix cache). We can also add a temporary server-side heuristic: if input length bytes > 50k and high non-ascii ratio, skip normalization.

maria: Customer needs ETA — can we do a quick rollback of tokenizer for eden-v1 in hosted for the next few hours?

ci-bot: deploy-bot: rollback request created: PR #4723 -> rollback eden-v1 tokenizer merge table. CI checks queued.

kevin: I'm going to TTL the canary to 10% for eden-v1 and set fallback model to eden-v1-small for >50k token inputs. Also throttling large-request concurrent slots to 2. I'll watch p95/p99. I'll update infra dashboard.

noah: I can instrument a synthetic load and confirm p99 reduction post-rollback. Will post numbers in ~30m.

sanjay: Also add an eval to detect normalization-triggered slowpaths: take N samples with high CJK density and assert tokenization time < 500ms. Add alert if regression > 2x.

maria: Action items:
- kevin: enable canary + fallback + throttling (oncall) 
- ci-bot: complete rollback PR #4723 (infra)
- noah: run synthetic validation and post results in thread
- sanjay: add regression eval + alert rule

maria: I'll keep ACME updated: told them we're rolling back tokenizer and will run validation.

noah: quick update — after rollback to eden-v1-tok-legacy on canary, p99 dropped from 2.1s -> 480ms in our synthetic. Will open a short postmortem with perf graphs.

maria: thanks all, closing once rollback confirmed for all regions. :thumbsup:
